caption: The drawing is divided into several sections bordered with a tan frame. The top left section displays a labeled site plan titled "Plan of Ground including Parterre," showing an overhead view of a landscape layout with green lawns, rounded green trees, and a central tan pathway leading to a red-roofed, brown-rectangled house centered in the composition. Around the house is a geometric parterre garden outlined in tan and green with white decorative elements. Adjacent to the right, a section labeled "Front view of House" presents a colored architectural elevation of a two-story villa with tan stone walls, columned portico, arched windows, and a red-tiled roof, with three chimneys and a tower feature on the right side. Green shrubbery and a large tree labeled "Prickly Acanthus" are drawn beside the house. Below these sections, at left, a detailed parterre garden plan labeled "Terrace Parterre" occupies a rectangular box, showing an octagonal arrangement with green garden beds edged by tan paths. At right, below the house elevation, is a vertical panel depicting a water fountain with streams of water and surrounding landscaped gardens, with the words "A Villa in the Italian style by A J Downing 1843" written below in blue and brown script. At the bottom, flanking the central text, are two large decorative urns on square plinths, each holding a spiky-leaved green plant. The overall palette consists of greens, tans, reds, and browns, with details rendered in black ink.
title: Italian Style Villa
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
